Job Title: Human Resources Assistant
Employer: Cedarline Outdoor Co.
Division: People and Culture
Work Term: Spring 2027
Term Length: 4 months
Job Location: Victoria, BC
Work Arrangement: On-site
Application Deadline: March 6, 2027
Salary: $22.00 per hour
Number of Positions: 2

Job Summary

Cedarline Outdoor Co. designs and sells camping equipment across Western Canada. The
Human Resources Assistant will support recruitment coordination and onboarding for our
seasonal retail teams.

Responsibilities

- Schedule interviews and maintain candidate records
- Support onboarding paperwork and orientation logistics
- Maintain employee records in the HRIS

Required Skills

- Coursework in human resources or business administration
- Strong attention to detail
